content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Come for the fish, stay for the fish — the Oceanário is a proper deep dive into the big blue."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The Gulbenkian gardens alone are worth the wander, and the collection spans everything from Egyptian cats to René Lalique glass."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb up for those castle walls and the best sprawl of terracotta rooftops in town."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Rattle through the old neighbourhoods on the little yellow tram, if the queue hasn't eaten the afternoon."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander Alfama's tiled lanes and catch laundry flapping like bunting."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sweeping views over the red rooftops, best with a breeze and a sigh."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A classic bifana and a cold beer, cheap and cheerful."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bairro Alto wakes late, so stroll the lanes as the lights flicker on."}]}
Alfama to Belém to castles and the ocean, with grilled sardines every single night — come for the sardines, stay for the sardines!
